lead_with.title: Targeting antibodies for DEP conjugates
lead_with.text: For a DEP-based ADC or radioconjugate, the antibody decides tumour targeting. MAbSilico can design or optimize binders (affinity, specificity, **conjugation-friendly developability**) in ~21 days.

lead_with.title: Developability for CMC
lead_with.text: Aynaz's CMC lens: MAbSilico screens developability in silico and validates with partner **Sartorius** — fewer surprises in manufacturing.

lead_with.title: Small, milestone-based project
lead_with.text: Cash is limited but runway reaches FY28. Offer a defined first project on one target (e.g. HER2 alternatives or a new tumour antigen).

company.text: Starpharma (Melbourne, ASX: SPL; CEO **Cheryl Maley**) develops oncology medicines using its **DEP® dendrimer** platform, which can carry drugs or radioisotopes and improve their delivery. Lead asset: **DEP® HER2-Lutetium** radiopharmaceutical, plus clinical DEP assets and preclinical next-generation programs. In Sep 2025 it out-licensed DEP technology to **Genentech** in a deal worth over US$569M; shares are up more than 500% over 12 months (as of Aug 2026).

financials.text: **FY26 (to Jun 30, 2026):** revenue A$12.0M (+145%, mainly Genentech); loss A$7.5M (from A$10.0M); R&D A$11.1M. **Cash:** A$11.0M at year-end, plus a **A$30M** entitlement offer after year-end; runway into **FY28**. Small but funded — suits a focused, milestone-based project.

industry.title: Targeted conjugates boom
industry.text: ADCs and radioligand therapies are among oncology's hottest areas; differentiated targeting antibodies are a key bottleneck.

industry.title: Delivery platforms partner with binder makers
industry.text: Platform companies like Starpharma license or partner for targeting moieties rather than building antibody discovery in-house.

talking_points: Which **targets** are you exploring for DEP conjugates beyond HER2?
Do you source targeting antibodies today (licensed, biosimilar, in-house)?
What antibody properties matter most for DEP conjugation — size/format, conjugation sites, stability?
Would a 21-day in-silico design on one target fit your preclinical plan?
Who decides on new discovery partners — Melanie, R&D leadership?
